claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.not_wielding_shield
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Monk Unarmored Defense is conditioned on 'not wearing armor OR wielding a Shield'. The current EquipmentPredicate has 'unarmored' (covers no armor) but no predicate for 'not wielding a shield'. Shield is not a weapon, so wielding_weapon doesn't apply. Barbarian Unarmored Defense has no shield restriction, so this cannot fold into the existing 'unarmored' sentinel without changing its semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ac_set_base with two ability modifiers
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ModifyAcSetBaseEffect is { const: number, abilityMod: Ability } — a single ability modifier. Monk Unarmored Defense requires base AC = 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod, which is two modifiers in a unified base formula. Composing modify_ac_set_base (10 + DEX) + modify_ac (+WIS) is numerically equivalent but semantically wrong: it represents 'base is 10+DEX, plus an additive WIS bonus' rather than 'base is 10+DEX+WIS', which interacts differently with mechanics that replace or read the base AC. The type needs either a second optional abilityMod field or a new two-modifier variant.
